info.title: html-preview API
info.description: Deploy static HTML previews and get a stable URL. Generated from the same Zod schemas as the server.

put.summary: One-shot deploy: send an HTML page, zip, tar.gz or multipart files

schema.description: A single page, stored as index.html
A folder as zip; a single top-level folder is stripped
A folder as tar.gz; a single top-level folder is stripped
One part per file, the file name is the path

patch.summary: Change visibility, ttl, pinned or rename

delete.summary: Delete a preview and its deployments

post.summary: Point the preview at an earlier deployment
Manifest step: declare files by sha256 and get the blobs still missing
Verify blobs and promote the deployment atomically

get.summary: Read one file (served as text/plain or octet-stream)
Share links of a private preview (no secrets)

post.summary: Create a share link for a private preview (URL shown once)

expiresInHours.description: Hours until the link stops working (1 to 720, default 168)

label.description: Who or what the link is for

201.description: The link with its secret URL

delete.summary: Revoke a share link; it stops working immediately

put.summary: Upload a blob by content hash

schema.description: The exact bytes whose SHA-256 is in the path

post.summary: Create an API key (token shown once)

get.summary: Totals, per-key usage and quota headroom

post.summary: Snapshot the database under DATA_DIR/backups (VACUUM INTO)

Error.description: Error with a stable code and a fix hint

Unauthorized.description: UNAUTHORIZED: missing or invalid API key

Forbidden.description: INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE: the key lacks the required scope
